method.ita: arctan((L*-50)/b*) * 180/pi, median over non-burn skin pixels
method.skin_rule: conjunction of RGB (Kovac) and YCbCr (Chai & Ngan) rules
method.burn_excluded: internal: ground-truth masked/unmasked pair; external: rasterised YOLO polygons; both dilated 6 px
method.caveat: ITA from uncontrolled web photographs is a proxy for apparent skin tone in the image, not a measurement of constitutive phototype. No ground-truth skin-type labels exist for this dataset. Exploratory only.
